title: How to Bootstrap to $23M in SaaS ARR in 4 years: Dubb podcast blurb (host summary only)
summary: A short show-notes blurb written by host Ruben Dua for a Connection Loop podcast episode with Adam Robinson. It summarizes his story (a stall at $3M ARR, then Retention.com to $23M ARR in four years), but contains no direct words from Adam and no transcript.
